sn4.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme ||
sn4.12:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti || || 2.
sn4.12:2.1: Atha kho Mārassa pāpimato etad ahosi || ||
sn4.12:2.2: Ayaṃ kho samaṇo Gotamo mahatiyā parisayā parivuto dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn4.12:2.3: Yaṃ nūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo Gotamo ten-upasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā ti || || 3.
sn4.12:2.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.12:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || jānāti mam Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti || dukkhī dummano tath-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
